purpose: Full serial gate vehicle for ten independently reviewed editor/markdown PRs. Each PR branch remains separate; this branch proves the combined tree passes the whole suite.

environment.profiles: disposable VS Code profiles recreated by global setup

notes: Two defects were found and fixed before this run: PR 702's new selection expectation was contradicted by Obsidian's toggleNumberList and CodeMirror mapping; four files were left unformatted by the PRs and a Prettier-only commit fixed them.
Redacted: no cookies, tokens, panel ids or personal paths in the logs beyond local worktree paths.
